sentences.text: Carbon monoxide is a colorless, odorless gas in engine and generator exhaust, and it kills boaters every year.
It builds up near the stern, on and around the swim platform, and in enclosed cabins.
Underway, the station wagon effect can draw exhaust back aboard, especially with a canvas enclosure.
Early symptoms, like headache, nausea and dizziness, are easily mistaken for seasickness.

Install and test carbon monoxide alarms in enclosed spaces, never let anyone hang on the swim platform or teak-surf with an engine or generator running, and move anyone with symptoms into fresh air and get medical help.
